$comment: Securden PAM evidence field meanings and NIST SP 800-53 Control Mapping Matrix alignment.

account_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the managed account or service credential in Securden PAM.
account_id.shows: Which privileged or non-privileged account owns the credential rotation record.

privileged.meaning: Whether the managed account is classified as a privileged account.
privileged.shows: Scope filter distinguishing privileged accounts from regular accounts.

last_rotated_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account password, secret, or SSH key was last rotated.
last_rotated_at.shows: Whether credentials were rotated within the required maximum age in days (NIST IA-5, IA-5(1), SC-12).

last_rotation_status.meaning: Outcome of the most recent automated or on-demand credential rotation attempt.
last_rotation_status.shows: SUCCESS when password, secret, or SSH key rotation succeeded; FAILED when rotation failed (NIST IA-5, IA-5(1), IA-5(2), IA-5(6), IA-5(7), SC-12, SC-13, SC-17, SC-28).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the credential rotation snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp used as reporting period anchor when last_rotated_at is null (NIST IA-5, IA-5(1)).

account_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the account in Securden PAM.
account_id.shows: Which account record is being evaluated for lifecycle or dormancy.

owner_id.meaning: Identifier of the user or custodian who owns or is responsible for the privileged account.
owner_id.shows: Account ownership and individual custodian assignment for privileged accounts (NIST AC-2, IA-4).

privileged.meaning: Whether the account holds privileged or administrative access rights.

enabled.meaning: Whether the account is currently active and enabled for use in Securden PAM.
enabled.shows: Scope filter selecting enabled accounts to verify none has remained unused past the dormancy threshold.

created_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account was onboarded or created in Securden PAM.
created_at.shows: Account onboarding timestamp within the reporting period.

last_used_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account was last accessed or used for a session or checkout.
last_used_at.shows: Whether an active privileged account has been used within the maximum allowed dormancy days (NIST AC-2, AC-2(2), AC-2(3), AC-2(13), IA-4).

session_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged remote session launched through Securden PAM.
session_id.shows: Which interactive RDP, SSH, database, or web session is being evaluated.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the target privileged account used during the session.
account_id.shows: Which managed account was accessed in the session.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the PAM user who initiated the privileged session.
user_id.shows: Individual accountability for the privileged session.

started_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged session started.
started_at.shows: When the session occurred within the reporting period.

ended_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged session terminated.
ended_at.shows: Whether the session has been properly terminated (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-12, AC-17, SC-10).

recording_required.meaning: Whether session recording is mandated by policy for this privileged session.
recording_required.shows: Scope filter selecting sessions that require session recording.

recording_status.meaning: Availability and completeness status of the session recording artifact.
recording_status.shows: AVAILABLE when a full video/keystroke recording exists; PARTIAL, MISSING, FAILED, or PROCESSING otherwise (NIST AU-14, AC-17, AC-17(1), MA-4).

recording_reference.meaning: Opaque identifier referencing the stored session recording file or trail.
recording_reference.shows: Whether a verifiable recording artifact link exists (exists / non-null) for audit playback (NIST AU-14, IR-7).

credential_reset_after_use.meaning: Whether the account credential was automatically reset or invalidated immediately following session termination.
credential_reset_after_use.shows: One-time-use credential invalidation protecting against post-session replay (NIST IA-5(1), SC-12).

access_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged access or checkout event.
access_id.shows: Which privileged access request or JIT elevation event is being checked.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user requesting or exercising privileged access.
user_id.shows: Which user accessed the privileged account.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the privileged account accessed.
account_id.shows: Which target account was requested or elevated.

accessed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged access occurred.
accessed_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

approval_required.meaning: Whether policy requires prior approval before granting access to this account.
approval_required.shows: Scope filter selecting access events governed by an approval workflow.

approval_status.meaning: Workflow approval state at the time privileged access was exercised.
approval_status.shows: APPROVED when authorized via request-release workflow or JIT elevation; PENDING, DENIED, or NONE when unapproved (NIST AC-2, AC-3(2), AC-6, AC-6(1), AC-6(2), CM-3, CM-5).

approval_id.meaning: Identifier of the approval workflow record authorizing the access.
approval_id.shows: Whether a formal approval or ITSM ticket record exists (exists / non-null) for the access (NIST AC-2, CM-3).

approved_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the request was approved.
approved_at.shows: Whether approval was recorded within the required timeframe (exists / non-null).

approver_id.meaning: Identifier of the designated approver who authorized the request.
approver_id.shows: Whether an accountable approver authorized the privileged access (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-2, AC-3(2), AC-5).

approvals_required.meaning: Number of approvals required by policy before the access request is granted.
approvals_required.shows: Threshold of required approvers (e.g. dual authorization / two-person rule) (NIST AC-2, AC-2(4), AC-6).

approvals_received.meaning: Number of valid approvals actually recorded for this request.
approvals_received.shows: Whether the required quorum of approvals was attained prior to granting access (NIST AC-2, AC-2(4), AC-6).

credential_reset_after_use.meaning: Whether the credential checked out under this request was reset after completion.
credential_reset_after_use.shows: Enforcement of post-use credential revocation or password change (NIST IA-5(1), SC-12).

access_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged account access event.
access_id.shows: Which access event is being checked against RBAC entitlements.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user who performed the account access.

accessed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account access occurred.
accessed_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

entitlement_status.meaning: Authorization status of the user's entitlement to the account at the time of access.
entitlement_status.shows: AUTHORIZED when permitted by an active RBAC role, folder, or account grant; NOT_AUTHORIZED, REVOKED, or UNKNOWN when unauthorized (NIST AC-2, AC-2(7), AC-3, AC-6, AC-6(1), AC-6(2), AC-6(3), AC-6(5), AC-6(10), CM-5).

entitlement_id.meaning: Identifier of the account, folder, or role entitlement granting access.
entitlement_id.shows: Whether a specific entitlement grant record exists (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-2, AC-3, AC-6).

entitlement_valid_from.meaning: UTC start timestamp of a time-bound access entitlement.
entitlement_valid_from.shows: When the granted access window began (exists / non-null).

entitlement_valid_to.meaning: UTC expiration timestamp of a temporary or time-bound access entitlement.
entitlement_valid_to.shows: Whether temporary/vendor/JIT access has an explicit expiration timestamp (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-2(2), IA-8).

principal_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the user principal attempting authentication.
principal_id.shows: Which user account experienced consecutive failed logon attempts.

window_start.meaning: UTC start timestamp of the authentication observation window.
window_start.shows: Start of the failed logon measurement interval.

window_end.meaning: UTC end timestamp of the authentication observation window.
window_end.shows: Reporting period timestamp for the authentication summary record.

failed_attempts.meaning: Count of consecutive unsuccessful logon attempts recorded for the principal in the window.
failed_attempts.shows: Whether failed logon attempts stayed at or below the organization's max_failed_attempts threshold (NIST AC-7 a, AC-7(2)).

lockout_triggered.meaning: Whether automatic account lockout was enforced after invalid logon attempts.
lockout_triggered.shows: True when automatic account lockout is enforced upon reaching the failed logon limit (NIST AC-7 b).

event_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the emergency break-glass access activation event.
event_id.shows: Which emergency access event is being evaluated.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user who activated emergency break-glass access.
user_id.shows: Individual accountability for emergency access usage.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the privileged account accessed via break-glass.
account_id.shows: Which account was accessed under emergency procedures.

activated_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when emergency break-glass access was activated.
activated_at.shows: When the break-glass event occurred within the reporting period.

justification_provided.meaning: Whether the user supplied a documented reason when activating break-glass access.
justification_provided.shows: True when a justification was recorded; false when break-glass was used without justification (NIST AC-2, IR-4, CP-10).

justification_length.meaning: Character length of the emergency access justification supplied by the user.
justification_length.shows: Whether the justification meets the minimum required character length threshold.

ticket_reference.meaning: Incident or change ticket identifier linked to the break-glass event.
ticket_reference.shows: Whether an incident or change ticket reference was recorded (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-2, CM-3, IR-4).

post_review_completed.meaning: Whether a post-activation audit review of the emergency access event was completed.
post_review_completed.shows: True when the break-glass event underwent mandatory post-usage review; false otherwise (NIST AC-2, IR-4).

post_review_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the post-activation review was completed.
post_review_at.shows: Whether the post-usage review occurred within the required number of days.

exception_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the policy or Separation of Duties (SoD) exception.
exception_id.shows: Which policy waiver or SoD exception is being evaluated.

rule_id.meaning: Identifier of the policy rule or SoD control covered by the exception.
rule_id.shows: Which control rule the exception applies to.

status.meaning: Current lifecycle status of the policy or SoD exception.
status.shows: ACTIVE when currently valid and approved; EXPIRED or REVOKED when no longer valid (NIST AC-5, CA-5, CA-7).

approved_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the policy exception was approved.
approved_at.shows: When the exception was granted within the assessment window.

expires_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the policy exception expires.
expires_at.shows: Whether the exception is still within its approved validity window (NIST AC-5).

last_used_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the exception was last relied upon.
last_used_at.shows: Recent usage of the policy exception.

account_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the account or entitlement item subject to periodic access review.
account_id.shows: Which account's access privileges are being reviewed.

privileged.meaning: Whether the reviewed account is a privileged account.
privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting privileged accounts for access review checks.

enabled.meaning: Whether the reviewed account is currently enabled.

owner_id.meaning: Identifier of the designated owner of the account.
owner_id.shows: Whether the account has an assigned owner (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-2).

reviewer_id.meaning: Identifier of the reviewer who completed the access certification decision.
reviewer_id.shows: Whether an accountable reviewer attested to the review (exists / non-null) (NIST AC-2(j), AC-5, AC-6(7)).

last_review_completed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the most recent periodic access review was completed for the account.
last_review_completed_at.shows: Whether the account's access privileges were reviewed within the required review_interval_days (NIST AC-2(j), AC-6(7), CA-7).

last_review_outcome.meaning: Attestation decision recorded by the reviewer during the latest access certification campaign.
last_review_outcome.shows: CERTIFIED when access was verified and re-approved; REVOKED when access violated policy or SoD (NIST AC-2(j), AC-5, AC-6(7), PS-4, PS-5).

source_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the Securden PAM audit log source or telemetry stream.
source_id.shows: Which audit log subsystem is being checked for completeness and integrity.

coverage_start.meaning: UTC start timestamp of the audit log coverage interval.
coverage_start.shows: Beginning of the monitored audit collection window.

coverage_end.meaning: UTC end timestamp of the audit log coverage interval.
coverage_end.shows: Reporting period timestamp for the audit coverage summary.

expected_event_count.meaning: Number of audit events expected from the audit source during the interval.
expected_event_count.shows: Baseline event volume expected for complete audit capture.

received_event_count.meaning: Number of audit events actually recorded and retained from the audit source.
received_event_count.shows: Whether audit logging is actively capturing and retaining events (NIST AU-2, AU-4, AU-6, AU-11, AU-12, SI-4).

max_gap_seconds.meaning: Longest gap in seconds between consecutive audit health or event recordings in the period.
max_gap_seconds.shows: Whether audit collection operated continuously within max_allowed_gap_seconds (NIST AU-5, AU-6, AU-11, AU-12, SI-4).

integrity_verified.meaning: Whether the audit trail passed integrity and tamper-protection verification.
integrity_verified.shows: True when audit records and logging tools are protected against unauthorized access, modification, and deletion (NIST AU-9, AU-9(4), AU-9(6), AU-11).

event_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the individual audit log entry.
event_id.shows: Which audit record is being inspected for required AU-3 content elements.

occurred_at.meaning: Synchronized UTC timestamp when the audited event occurred.
occurred_at.shows: When the event occurred within the reporting period (AU-3/AU-8 timestamp requirement).

event_type.meaning: Classification identifier indicating what type of event occurred.
event_type.shows: Whether the audit record captures the type of event (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-2, AU-3 a, AU-12, AC-2(4), AC-6(9)).

location_id.meaning: Identifier of the system component or server where the event occurred.
location_id.shows: Whether the audit record captures where the event occurred (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-3 c).

source_id.meaning: Identifier of the originating host, client IP address, or source of the event.
source_id.shows: Whether the audit record captures the source of the event (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-3 d).

outcome.meaning: Result of the audited action (SUCCESS, FAILURE, DENIED, or ERROR).
outcome.shows: Whether the audit record captures the outcome of the event (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-3 e).

actor_id.meaning: Identifier of the individual user or subject associated with the event.
actor_id.shows: Whether the audit record identifies the individual user/actor who performed the action (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-3 f, AU-12(4), AC-6(9)).

target_id.meaning: Identifier of the target account, object, or entity acted upon.
target_id.shows: Whether the audit record identifies the target object or account affected (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-3 f, AC-2(4), AU-12(4)).

principal_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the user or account principal in Securden PAM.
principal_id.shows: Which principal's MFA configuration snapshot is being evaluated.

principal_type.meaning: Whether the principal is a USER or an ACCOUNT.
principal_type.shows: Type of principal (USER or ACCOUNT) subject to MFA enforcement.

privileged.meaning: Whether the principal holds privileged access rights in Securden PAM.
privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting privileged users or accounts.

enabled.meaning: Whether the principal is currently enabled for login.

mfa_enforced.meaning: Whether multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enforced for this principal by policy.
mfa_enforced.shows: True when MFA is required for the user; false when single-factor login is permitted (NIST IA-2, IA-2(1), IA-2(2), IA-2(8), IA-2(12)).

mfa_methods.meaning: List of MFA factor methods configured for the principal (totp, push, fido2, smart_card, hardware_token, sms, email_otp).
mfa_methods.shows: Which authenticators are enrolled for the principal.

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the MFA configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

access_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged access authentication event.
access_id.shows: Which privileged access attempt is being evaluated.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user authenticating for privileged access.
user_id.shows: Individual user accountability for the authentication event.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the target privileged account being accessed.

accessed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged access authentication occurred.
accessed_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

access_granted.meaning: Whether privileged access was granted following the authentication check.
access_granted.shows: True when access was granted after individual authentication; false when blocked (NIST IA-2, IA-8).

mfa_status.meaning: Result of multi-factor authentication verification for this privileged access event.
mfa_status.shows: VERIFIED when individual MFA authentication succeeded before granting privileged or shared-account access; NOT_PERFORMED, FAILED, or UNKNOWN otherwise (NIST IA-2, IA-2(1), IA-2(2), IA-2(5), IA-2(6), IA-5 a/h, IA-8, AC-17).

mfa_method.meaning: Specific MFA factor used to verify the user (totp, push, fido2, smart_card, hardware_token, sms, email_otp).
mfa_method.shows: Which multi-factor method was completed when mfa_status is VERIFIED (exists / non-null).

policy_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the session timeout policy in Securden PAM.
policy_id.shows: Which session management policy snapshot is being checked.

applies_to_privileged.meaning: Whether this session policy governs privileged sessions and administrative interfaces.
applies_to_privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting session policies that apply to privileged access.

idle_timeout_enabled.meaning: Whether automatic session lock or termination upon inactivity is enabled.
idle_timeout_enabled.shows: True when idle interactive sessions are automatically locked or terminated; false when sessions never time out (NIST AC-11, AC-12, SC-10).

idle_timeout_minutes.meaning: Configured inactivity timeout duration in minutes before a session is locked or terminated.
idle_timeout_minutes.shows: Whether the idle timeout duration is at most max_idle_minutes (NIST AC-11 a, AC-12).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the session policy configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

elevation_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the endpoint privilege elevation request or grant event.
elevation_id.shows: Which local or JIT privilege elevation event on the endpoint is being evaluated (NIST AC-6(10), CM-11).

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user requesting or executing privilege elevation on the endpoint.

device_id.meaning: Identifier of the endpoint workstation, server, or device where elevation occurred.
device_id.shows: Which target device was subject to privilege elevation.

requested_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when endpoint privilege elevation was requested.
requested_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

approval_status.meaning: Approval state of the elevation request (APPROVED, AUTO_APPROVED, PENDING, DENIED).
approval_status.shows: APPROVED or AUTO_APPROVED when authorized by policy or approver; PENDING or DENIED when unauthorized (NIST AC-6(10), CM-11).

application_id.meaning: Identifier of the specific application or binary elevated with administrative rights.
application_id.shows: Which application was executed with elevated privileges (NIST CM-11).

approver_id.meaning: Identifier of the designated authority who approved the endpoint elevation.
approver_id.shows: Accountable approver for the elevation grant (exists / non-null).

approved_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the endpoint elevation request was approved.
approved_at.shows: Approval timestamp within policy time bounds.

elevation_expires_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when temporary endpoint administrative elevation expires.
elevation_expires_at.shows: Enforcement of time-bound Just-in-Time elevation on the endpoint (NIST AC-6(10)).

revoked_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the elevated rights were explicitly revoked or terminated.
revoked_at.shows: Timely revocation of elevated endpoint privileges.

device_id.meaning: Identifier of the endpoint workstation or server hosting the local Administrators group.
device_id.shows: Which endpoint's local administrative membership is being evaluated (NIST AC-6(5)).

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the user or group account present in the local administrative group.
account_id.shows: Which account holds local administrator rights on the device.

approved_member.meaning: Whether this account is an explicitly authorized and policy-approved member of the local administrative group.
approved_member.shows: True when local admin rights are sanctioned; false when unauthorized administrative rights exist (NIST AC-6(5)).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the local admin membership snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

policy_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the application whitelisting/blacklisting control policy.
policy_id.shows: Which application execution control policy snapshot is being checked (NIST CM-7(4), CM-7(5)).

mode.meaning: Operational mode of application control (ALLOWLIST, BLOCKLIST, MONITOR).
mode.shows: ALLOWLIST for strict unauthorized software blocking; BLOCKLIST or MONITOR otherwise (NIST CM-7(4), CM-7(5)).

enforced.meaning: Whether the application control policy is actively enforced on target systems.
enforced.shows: True when execution restrictions are strictly enforced to prevent unauthorized software (NIST CM-7(4), CM-7(5)).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the application control policy snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

policy_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the password or authenticator policy configuration.
policy_id.shows: Which password configuration snapshot is being evaluated (NIST IA-5(1)).

applies_to_privileged.meaning: Whether this password policy configuration applies to privileged accounts and administrators.
applies_to_privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting password policies that govern privileged credentials.

min_length.meaning: Configured minimum password length in characters.
min_length.shows: Whether the required minimum length meets or exceeds the regulatory threshold (NIST IA-5(1)).

complexity_required.meaning: Whether password complexity (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters) is strictly required.
complexity_required.shows: True when multi-character-class complexity is enforced (NIST IA-5(1)).

enforced_on_reset.meaning: Whether policy rules are strictly enforced upon password reset and creation.
enforced_on_reset.shows: True when non-compliant passwords cannot be set during reset or change (NIST IA-5(1)).

rotation_period_days.meaning: Configured maximum password lifetime in days before forced change.
rotation_period_days.shows: Whether credentials expire within the allowable maximum rotation age (NIST IA-5(1)).

history_count.meaning: Number of previous passwords remembered to prohibit reuse.
history_count.shows: Whether password history depth meets or exceeds required count to prevent password reuse (NIST IA-5(1)).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the password policy configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

destination_id.meaning: Identifier of the centralized logging target (SIEM, Syslog server, or audit repository).
destination_id.shows: Which audit forwarding destination is configured (NIST AU-4(1), AU-6(4)).

protocol.meaning: Transport protocol utilized for log forwarding (SYSLOG, API, OTHER).
protocol.shows: Forwarding protocol used to transmit audit records off-host (NIST AU-4(1)).

enabled.meaning: Whether audit event forwarding to the centralized repository is actively enabled.
enabled.shows: True when off-system audit trail delivery is operational and enabled (NIST AU-4(1), AU-6(4)).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the audit forwarding configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

last_delivery_at.meaning: UTC timestamp of the most recently verified audit batch delivery.
last_delivery_at.shows: Recent activity verifying audit delivery pipeline health (exists / non-null) (NIST AU-4(1)).

backup_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the backup job or policy configuration.
backup_id.shows: Which system or credential backup configuration is being evaluated (NIST CP-9(8)).

scheduled.meaning: Whether automated scheduled backups are enabled for system and credential data.
scheduled.shows: True when regular automated backups are scheduled (NIST CP-9(8)).

encrypted.meaning: Whether backup archives are cryptographically encrypted at rest.
encrypted.shows: True when backup media is encrypted protecting confidentiality and integrity (NIST CP-9(8)).

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the backup configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

last_backup_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the most recent backup execution occurred.
last_backup_at.shows: Recency of backup execution within maximum allowed recovery point intervals (NIST CP-9(8)).

last_backup_status.meaning: Outcome status of the most recent backup execution (SUCCESS, FAILED).
last_backup_status.shows: SUCCESS when backup completed without error; FAILED otherwise (NIST CP-9(8)).
